title: Client Template Studio typed mapping and record contracts
description: Schema version 1. Existing canonical engagement entities remain authoritative. This schema describes pure mapping/exchange records, not a separate canonical store. Runtime validation additionally checks exact canonical field ownership, bounded expression depth, dimensional unit conversions, selected-account and period scope, approved review identity/date/statement, safe anchors and cited record membership. Private learning signatures are non-security lookup hints and never grant authority or contain source text. Registry persistence has its own versioned envelope and immutable digest checks.

reviewedManualNativeAnchor.description: Exact original hash, native XML location and reviewed source text for a manually defined Office input. Runtime independently reopens original bytes and rejects overlapping fields, formulas, protected sheets and ambiguous merged regions. Registration is not mapping or template approval.
